query: Civiqs Trump national net approval daily tracker September 2026

results.content:
YouGov polls about 1,500 members of its national opt-in panel weekly using online questionnaires. State-level approval rates are “estimated” based on demographic characteristics, voting behavior, the state’s voting history and other data. Nationally, YouGov’s tracker shows 34% approving of Trump’s job performance and 61% disapproving, for a net approval rating of -27. [...] In May, a poll of 875 likely voters conducted by Keloland Media Group and Emerson College showed Trump with a 53% approval rating, while 42% disapproved.

Civiqs estimated that 51% of South Dakotans approved of Trump’s job performance as of Aug. 11.

This fact brief responds to claims such as this one.

According to Civiqs, last updated August 12, Trump's net approval in New Jersey stood at -35%.

New Jersey tilts unfavorable overall. About 65% of New Jersey residents polled currently disapprove of the president's performance.About 30% approve and another 5% did not choose either.

Education: Respondents across all education levels disapprove of Trump’s job performance, with postgraduate at 78%, college graduate at 67% and non-college graduate at 60%. [...] Party: Democrats were most unfavorable toward Trump, with 98% disapproving, followed by independents at 62% disapproval. Meanwhile, Republicans were the most favorable toward Trump, with 82% approving of Trump's job performance.
